description: Source code defining serialization and deserialization logic for MetricViewV01 and ColumnV01 classes in Spark SQL's metricview module, including conversion from canonical representations and YAML serialization support.

classes.name: ColumnV01
classes.description: Data class representing a column with name and expression, version 01.

classes.name: MetricViewV01
classes.description: Data class representing a metric view with version, source, filter, dimensions, and measures.

classes.name: YamlMapperProviderV01
classes.description: Object providing YAML mapping configuration for version 01.

classes.name: MetricViewYAMLDeserializerV01
classes.description: Object for deserializing MetricViewV01 objects from YAML.

classes.name: MetricViewYAMLSerializerV01
classes.description: Object for serializing MetricViewV01 objects to YAML.

methods.name: fromCanonical
methods.description: Converts a Column or MetricView from its canonical form to version 01 representation.
